description: Source code for the OV7725 camera sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including register definitions, initialization, configuration, and I2C communication functions.

methods.name: ov7725_write_reg
methods.description: Writes a value to a specified register over I2C.

methods.name: ov7725_read_reg
methods.description: Reads a value from a specified register over I2C.

methods.name: ov7725_modify_reg
methods.description: Modifies specific bits in a register.

methods.name: ov7725_write_all
methods.description: Writes a sequence of register-value pairs to the device.

methods.name: ov7725_set_clock
methods.description: Configures the sensor clock and timing registers based on desired framerate and input clock.

methods.name: ov7725_set_fmt
methods.description: Configures the sensor output format and resolution.

methods.name: ov7725_get_caps
methods.description: Provides the capabilities of the sensor.

methods.name: ov7725_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor, verifies device ID, resets, and sets default format.

methods.name: ov7725_init_0
methods.description: Instance-specific initialization, checks bus and GPIO readiness.
